title: Mekelle residents protest alleged looting by government forces
location: Mekelle, Tigray Regional State, Ethiopia; specific road(s)/site not named
crowd_size_evidence: No attendee count. Reuters reports residents blocked roads; neither report says how many participated, and the count of deaths/injuries is not a proxy for total attendance. ≥50 is unverified.

occurrence_and_date.value: Reuters via VOA (Dec4) reports TPLF leader's claim that protests were breaking out in Mekelle; Reuters Dec6 story says residents blocked roads and identifies looting/protests in Mekelle on Friday Dec4. Contemporaneous report supports an executed protest, with conflicting official portrayal.

attendance.value: Unknown; Reuters reports roadblocks but no count or clearly supported ≥50 threshold.

state_targeted_demand.value: Reuters describes residents protesting looting by government forces. No precise demand, addressee, or requested policy remedy is quoted; domestic-state target may be implicated but is not fully established.

inclusion_exclusion.value: Reported resident road-blocking protest is distinct from armed clashes; no attendee total and no basis to code armed participants as demonstrators. Do not merge with war events.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: Dated to Dec4; episode start/end and neighboring-month continuity are not resolved. Both captured items carry Reuters origin, so source independence is not established.

decision_note: Potential public protest supported by Reuters accounts, including a doctor reached in Mekelle; threshold and exact state-directed demand remain unsupported, and official/leader accounts conflict. Sources share Reuters origin; no participant count is inferred from deaths or injuries.
